description: This is a server-side Razor Page code-behind file for the ConfirmEmail page in an ASP.NET Core application. It handles email confirmation logic using the UserManager class to verify a user's email with a provided code.

classes.name: ConfirmEmailModel
classes.description: A PageModel class that manages email confirmation process for a user.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles GET requests to confirm a user's email by verifying the provided userId and code, and updating the email confirmation status.
